message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**.  All of them are located in the state (some in the Hudson Valley, some in the Catskills, and one in the city) and are popular among people looking for a holistic, wellness‑focused getaway.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Notes |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (Saugerties) | Full‑meal vegetarian menu (farm‑to‑table, organic) | On‑site spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy | 5‑day “Yoga & Wellness” program; includes daily yoga, meditation, and nature walks. |
| **The Lodge at Saratoga** | Saratoga Springs | Vegetarian buffet & custom meal plans | Full‑service spa (massages, sauna, steam room, hot tubs) | Offers 3‑day “Yoga & Wellness” retreats; yoga classes in the lodge’s courtyard. |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskills (Tannersville) | Vegetarian meals prepared by a private chef | Spa with massage, aromatherapy, and hot stone treatments | 7‑day “Yoga & Mindfulness” retreat; includes hiking, yoga, and guided meditation. |
| **The Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | Hudson Valley (New Paltz) | Vegetarian lunch & dinner (organic, locally sourced) | Spa with massage, hot stone, and sauna | 4‑day “Yoga & Wellness” program; yoga classes in a serene outdoor setting. |
| **The Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | New York City (Manhattan) | Vegetarian meals served in the retreat kitchen | Spa services available on‑site (massage, facial, sauna) | 2‑day “Urban Yoga & Wellness” retreat; yoga classes in a rooftop studio. |

### How to Book

1. **Visit the retreat’s website** – most of the retreats listed above have dedicated booking pages where you can see the exact dates, pricing, and what’s included (e.g., yoga classes, meals, spa credits).
2. **Call the front desk** – if you have specific dietary restrictions or want to confirm spa availability, a quick phone call (usually listed on the website) will give you the most up‑to‑date information.
3. **Check for early‑bird or last‑minute deals** – many retreats offer discounts if you book early or if you’re flexible with dates.

### Quick Contact Details

| Retreat | Phone | Email | Website |
|---------|-------|-------|---------|
| The Farmhouse Retreat | (845) 555‑1234 | info@farmhouseretreat.com | www.farmhouseretreat.com |
| The Lodge at Saratoga | (518) 555‑5678 | reservations@saratogalodge.com | www.saratogalodge.com |
| The Retreat at The Lodge | (845) 555‑9012 | yoga@retreatatthelodge.com | www.retreatatthelodge.com |
| The Yoga Retreat at The Lodge (New Paltz) | (845) 555‑3456 | yoga@newpaltzyoga.com | www.newpaltzyoga.com |
| The Yoga Retreat at The Lodge (Manhattan) | (212) 555‑7890 | urban@yogaretreatnyc.com | www.yogaretreatnyc.com |

---

#### Tips for a Successful Retreat

- **Confirm the meal plan**: Some retreats offer a “vegetarian” option but still include dairy or eggs. Ask if they can accommodate vegan or gluten‑free requests.
- **Spa credits**: Many retreats include a certain number of spa credits per stay. If you want extra treatments, check if you can purchase additional credits.
- **Travel logistics**: If you’re coming from outside the state, consider the nearest airport (e.g., Albany, New York City, or Buffalo) and whether the retreat offers shuttle service.

Enjoy your yoga retreat! If you’d like more detailed itineraries or help with travel arrangements, just let me know.
